name: Free Persistent Two-Match Storage Using Neon PostgreSQL (Bugfix Validated)

database.tier: Free Tier (0.5 GB persistent cloud storage, $0 cost)

retention_policy.algorithm: Pre-selection of newest up to 2 matches followed by single atomic transaction
retention_policy.ordering: recency_dt DESC, stored_at DESC, match_id DESC
retention_policy.deduplication: Provider matches deduplicated by stable match_id before selection; DB metadata updated in-place
retention_policy.post_sync_invariant_check: Guaranteed final count <= 2 (raises RuntimeError if count > 2)
retention_policy.section_16_mandatory_test: PASSED (Start [A, B] -> Insert C -> [B, C] -> Insert C -> [B, C] -> Insert D -> [C, D])

invariants.honest_fallback_message: Historical probability replay unavailable for this match because ball-by-ball data was not provided by the data source.

phase_12_3_bugfix_scenarios_verified: 1. 19 provider matches -> exactly 2 stored, no incremental pruning
2. Existing A,B in DB + provider returning C,D -> only C,D remain
3. Duplicate provider match -> no duplicate row created
5. Newer match replaces oldest match in DB
6. Zero valid matches -> existing records remain unchanged
7. Transaction failure -> previous records remain unchanged (atomic rollback)
9. Provider results containing duplicates deduplicated before selection

frontend_verification.theme: Phase 8.2.1 light cricket broadcast theme preserved
